title: Evaluating Machine-Learning Models for Multiclass Classification of LIGO Gravitational-Wave Glitches (Code and Reproducibility Package)
description: Code, configurations, lightweight numerical evidence, figure assets, and documentation supporting the original benchmark and the 2026 referee-driven revision. Version v1.1.0 adds the curated revision reproducibility package, including duplicate-aware split provenance, chronological generalization analyses, targeted ablations, common-method permutation importance, operational measurements, bandwidth augmentation, and feature-provenance and image-comparison audits. Large event-level datasets, trained models, predictions, checkpoints, and execution logs are not included.
